summary: Tested DM Accounting backend (11/11 pytest passed) and frontend. Backend fully functional including auth (bcrypt+JWT+httpOnly cookies), admin/client APIs, file upload, CSV parsing (totals match: income=62800, expense=10101.25), audit logs, and 403/401 guards. Frontend: public pages (Home/Services/About/Contact) render correctly with Greek nav, address Πατέλες Μιλτιάδου 9, email marinosgr@yahoo.gr, and Google Maps iframe. Admin login + dashboard works end-to-end (KPIs, Recharts bar chart, audit logs, client table, 'Νέος Πελάτης' modal opens). CRITICAL frontend bug: client login does not redirect to /dashboard after successful auth.

ui_bugs.issue: After submitting valid client credentials (client@dmaccounting.gr/Client2026!), URL stays at /login and user is not redirected to /dashboard. Backend POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with role=client and access_token (verified by pytest), so issue is in frontend post-login routing for the client role.

Modal does not close on Escape key press. It also lacks a backdrop-click close. The open modal blocks pointer events on 'Προβολή' (view-client) buttons behind it. Needs explicit close (X) button working or Escape handler.

integration_issues.issue: Login successful at API level but frontend remains on /login page. Could not verify Recharts revenue/expense/profit/VAT charts on /dashboard due to this redirect failure.

action_items: Fix Login.jsx: ensure that after POST /api/auth/login succeeds with role=='client', the app navigates to /dashboard (likely missing navigate('/dashboard') or auth context not updating in time before route guard runs). Admin redirect to /admin already works.
Fix create-client modal: add Escape key handler and/or backdrop click to close, and ensure modal unmounts after successful create. Also add explicit Close (X) button visible on screen.
After client login fix, retest /dashboard charts (income/expense/profit/VAT), files list, recent records UI rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 600+ lines; consider splitting routes/auth/parsing into modules.
scan_client_folder is called synchronously inside async route /admin/stats per client - O(N) filesystem reads on every stats call; cache or move to background job for scale.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env - acceptable for dev, but flag for production rotation.
set_auth_cookies uses SameSite=None+Secure which is correct for cross-origin preview, good.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook check mentioned 5-fail lockout) - login allows unlimited attempts.
MongoDB _id properly excluded in /api/admin/clients and /api/admin/stats - good.

seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded demo client + CSV. Test created and deleted ephemeral TEST_ clients via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py - reuse it. The critical bug to verify after fix: navigate to /login, log in as client@dmaccounting.gr/Client2026!, verify URL becomes /dashboard and Recharts charts (income/expense/profit/VAT) render with the seeded ~62800 income data. Also verify create-client modal can be closed via Escape/backdrop and 'Προβολή' on a client row works.
rca of the issue: Client login no-redirect: Backend returns 200 with full user object including role='client' and access_token. Admin login uses same endpoint and redirects fine to /admin. Likely cause in Login.jsx: conditional redirect uses if(role==='admin') navigate('/admin') else navigate('/admin') OR the client role branch is missing/typo'd OR auth context state hasn't updated before route guard runs. Inspect Login.jsx onSubmit handler around the if/else routing logic.
